[P2] Require coverage for non-finite model answers

The wrong-shape test rejects an incorrect answer type; all correctly typed numeric answers in the tests are finite. Removing this condition therefore leaves the assertions unchanged, although a custom transport returning `{ type: "noul", noul: NaN }` would checkpoint `false` instead of rejecting. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the validation/test design and require rejection of non-finite answers with an assertion that fails when this guard is removed.
